# scc_compliance_custodian (Data Source)

Look up an existing ComplianceCustodian object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
